messages.subject: Renjin user survey - please help!!
parts:
Hi all,
With the kick-off a 3-year EU-sponsored research project in which Renjin will play a prominent role, we're excited to be able to support Renjin development on a full-time basis. In addition to the research projects with CWI and Horizon 2020, we're exploring providing more commercial services around Renjin as we see it being used more and more in 'production.'

To this end, we'd really appreciate if you could take a moment to complete a short survey on how use (or don't use!) Renjin:

http://bit.ly/1VWXPcE

Whether you've only played with Renjin, or you're submitting pull requests regularly (thanks!) it would be great to understand your use case. 

Many thanks,
Alex
